Internal codename inspired by Jane Fonda's on-screen workout instruction, not impersonation.
Own frontend/ except player.ts, offline.ts, public/sw.js, package/config/lockfiles and other assigned audio runtime modules. Read docs/contracts.md. Render player state; never invent a second timer. Do not edit shared contracts, api/, dependencies, Git or cloud state. Validate changes and report exact tested behavior.
